instruction: Candid medium shot in a bright indoor room. On the right, the man in the yellow t-shirt (R2) holds the little girl in the light long-sleeve shirt (R1) high in the air. On the left, the woman in the white sleeveless top (R3) stands in profile, looking up and smiling warmly at the girl while gently touching her. Bright, natural light fills the room.
